title: Waiver.
bodyText:
(a) A debtor or secondary obligor may waive the right to notification of disposition of collateral under section 490:9-611 only by an agreement to that effect entered into and signed after default.

(b) A debtor may waive the right to require disposition of collateral under section 490:9-620(e) only by an agreement to that effect entered into and signed after default.

(c) Except in a consumer-goods transaction, a debtor or secondary obligor may waive the right to redeem collateral under section 490:9-623 only by an agreement to that effect entered into and signed after default.
bodyHtml:
§490:9-624  Waiver.  (a)  A debtor or secondary obligor may waive the right to notification of disposition of collateral under section 490:9-611 only by an agreement to that effect entered into and signed after default.

     (b)  A debtor may waive the right to require disposition of collateral under section 490:9-620(e) only by an agreement to that effect entered into and signed after default.

     (c)  Except in a consumer-goods transaction, a debtor or secondary obligor may waive the right to redeem collateral under section 490:9-623 only by an agreement to that effect entered into and signed after default. [L 2000, c 241, pt of §1; am L 2023, c 132, §64]
